critical.issue: Widget JS is generated with api = str(request.base_url) which resolves to the internal cluster hostname http://ai-manager-auto.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud on the K8s ingress. When the widget is embedded on ANY HTTPS site (including the app's own Embed page live preview iframe), the browser blocks the fetch with 'Mixed Content: ... blocked; the content must be served over HTTPS.' The Live Preview shows 'Unable to load blogs.' Fix: use env var (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL / PUBLIC_APP_URL) or read X-Forwarded-Proto / X-Forwarded-Host headers, or hardcode https:// scheme.

rca_of_the_issue: server.py line 435: `backend = str(request.base_url).rstrip('/')` — behind the K8s ingress, FastAPI sees the internal service URL rather than the external public HTTPS URL. Since widget.js is served as plain JS to third-party HTTPS sites, the embedded fetch/href absolute URLs must be HTTPS. Fix options: (1) read os.environ.get('PUBLIC_APP_URL') / REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and use that; (2) build the URL from `request.headers.get('x-forwarded-proto','https')` + `request.headers.get('x-forwarded-host', request.url.hostname)`; (3) just hardcode `https://` scheme + the Host header value. Same fix pattern should apply anywhere the backend needs to emit its own public URL.
